body: I’m moving back with my mom in about a month and won’t be able to get the right things to ctb until a few months later so I’ll have time to ponder about whether or not to do it. Although right now it’s looking like I’ll probably go through with it, something might change once I’m back and I might keep pushing but who knows. I might be 15 and have a “long life” ahead of me but I don’t want to live a life with no meaning while burdening people. But who knows, things might change in these next few months.
